Name: Adi Studio OS
Author: Adi Ariel
Description: Studio OS hub for the Stream Deck + XL. One navigable surface over all 36 keys and 6 dials: Ableton Live control, rekordbox MIDI, numpad and delay calculator, drum pads and scale touch, and live audio visualizers. Talks to a local Node service for native MIDI and OS routing.
_comment_profiles: No Profiles block on purpose. That key declares an EMBEDDED .streamDeckProfile, which is a binary the Stream Deck app alone can produce — declaring one we do not ship makes the app log 'dropped embedded profile (profile not found on disk)' at every launch. The surface is generated instead by scripts/make_profile.py, which writes the installed JSON form directly.

Actions.Name: Studio OS Cell
Actions.Tooltip: One key of the Studio OS surface. Place it on all 36 keys once — it reads its own coordinates and the plugin drives everything centrally. Nothing to configure per key.

Actions.Name: Studio OS Dial
Actions.Tooltip: One dial of the Studio OS surface. Place it on all 6 dials once — role and touch-strip zone follow the active hub and state.
